quote: مذاکرات نفت با شرکت نفت ایران و انگلیس و چند شرکت آمریکایی و اروپائی شروع شد که در آخر به قرارداد کنسرسیوم منجر شد.
translation: Oil talks with the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company and several American and European companies began and eventually led to the consortium agreement.

quote: По этому соглашению 40 % досталось Англо-иранской нефтяной компании, 40 % — пятёрке американских компаний (Gulf Oil, Socal, Esso, Socony, Texaco), 14 % — компании Shell, 6 % — французской компании.
translation: Under this agreement 40 percent went to the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, 40 percent to five American companies (Gulf Oil, Socal, Esso, Socony, Texaco), 14 percent to Shell and 6 percent to the French company.

quote: Dabei wurde der britische Anteil auf 40 % reduziert, bei gleichzeitigem Einstieg von fünf amerikanischen Ölgesellschaften mit 40 % Geschäftsanteil, 14 % gelangten an Royal Dutch Shell und 6 % an das französische Unternehmen CFP (später TotalEnergies).
translation: The British share was reduced to 40 percent, while five American oil companies entered with a 40 percent share, 14 percent went to Royal Dutch Shell and 6 percent to the French company CFP (later TotalEnergies).

quote: Pour ce qui est des parts étrangères, la part britannique est réduite à 40 %, avec introduction simultanée de cinq compagnies pétrolières américaines ayant 40 % des parts, et pour les 20 % restants, 14 % revinrent à la Royal Dutch Shell et 6 % à la société française CFP (plus tard Total).
translation: As for foreign shares, the British share is reduced to 40 percent, with five American oil companies simultaneously taking 40 percent, and of the remaining 20 percent, 14 percent went to Royal Dutch Shell and 6 percent to the French company CFP (later Total).

quote: como resultado, los ingresos petroleros aumentaron de $34 millones en 1954–1955 a $181 millones en 1956–1957 y continuaron aumentando, y Estados Unidos envió ayuda para el desarrollo y asesores.
translation: as a result, oil revenues rose from $34 million in 1954–1955 to $181 million in 1956–1957 and continued to rise, and the United States sent development aid and advisers.

quote: in result, oil revenues increased from $34 million in 1954–1955 to $181 million in 1956–1957, and continued increasing, and the United States sent development aid and advisers.

La réalité de l'opération Ajax est contestée par certains protagonistes des évènements de 1953, ainsi que par d'anciens hauts dirigeants de la CIA, qui soutiennent que le gouvernement Mossadegh a été renversé sous la pression populaire, après sa destitution par le chah selon les termes de la constitution de 1906.
section: Réfutations de l'opération et des interventions étrangères
translation: The reality of Operation Ajax is contested by some protagonists of the 1953 events and by former senior CIA officials, who maintain that Mosaddegh's government was overthrown under popular pressure after the Shah dismissed him under the 1906 constitution.

quote: In 2014, historian Ray Takeyh stated that the US-led coup attempt failed, citing how the CIA wrote to Eisenhower that "The move failed [...] We now [...] probably have to snuggle up to Mosaddeq if we're going to save [our influence in Iran];" the demonstrations that led to Mosaddegh's resignation took place some weeks after the Roosevelt-organized ones, and were composed of average citizens, not the thugs-for-hire that the CIA and MI6 had recruited.
در سال ۲۰۲۳، سیا مسئولیت کودتا را به عهده گرفت.
translation: In 2023, the CIA took responsibility for the coup.

quote: In 2023, the CIA took credit for the coup, this confirmed what many historians had already concluded before, though because portions of the agency's records were destroyed, or remained classified for years, some historians had initially argued, on the basis of incomplete evidence, that Iranian domestic actors played the primary role in the coup, with the U.S. and Britain serving mainly in a supporting capacity.
كما أوعز روزفلت إلى كبير زعران طهران وقتذاك شعبان جعفري بالسيطرة على الشارع، وإطلاق الهتافات التي تحط من هيبة مصدق؛
translation: Roosevelt also instructed Shaban Jafari, then Tehran's chief thug, to control the street and chant slogans that degraded Mosaddegh.

quote: By the middle of the day, large crowds of regular citizens, armed with improvised weapons, took to the streets in mass demonstrations, and beat back the Tudeh Party members.
شاه برخلاف قانون که محاکمه نخست‌وزیر را تنها توسط دیوان عالی کشور مجاز می‌شمرد، محمد مصدق را در دادگاه نظامی محاکمه و به سه سال حبس مجرد (انفرادی) محکوم کرد.
translation: Contrary to the law, which allowed a prime minister to be tried only by the Supreme Court, the Shah tried Mohammad Mosaddegh in a military court and sentenced him to three years of solitary confinement.

quote: Mosaddegh fue arrestado, juzgado y originalmente condenado a muerte. Pero por orden personal del sha, su sentencia fue conmutada por tres años de aislamiento en una prisión militar, seguido de arresto domiciliario hasta su muerte.
translation: Mosaddegh was arrested, tried and originally sentenced to death. But by the Shah's personal order his sentence was commuted to three years of solitary confinement in a military prison, followed by house arrest until his death.

quote: حَكَمَ نظام الشاه على الدكتور مصدق بالإعدام، ثم خفف الحكم لاحقاً إلى سجن انفرادي لثلاث سنوات؛ ومن ثم إقامة جبرية لمدى الحياة في قرية أحمد آباد، الواقعة في شمالي إيران ليترك الدكتور مصدق نهبا لذكرياته.
translation: The Shah's regime sentenced Dr Mosaddegh to death, then later reduced the sentence to three years of solitary confinement and then life house arrest in the village of Ahmadabad in northern Iran.

quote: On 21 December 1953, he was sentenced to three years in jail, then placed under house arrest for the remainder of his life.
بسته به هزینه‌هایی که باید محاسبه شود، هزینه نهایی از ۱۰۰۰۰۰ تا ۲۰ میلیون دلار تخمین زده می‌شود. سیا بعد از کودتا ۵ میلیون دلار به دولت زاهدی داد و خود زاهدی یک میلیون دلار اضافی دریافت کرد.
translation: Depending on which costs are counted, the final cost is estimated at $100,000 to $20 million. After the coup the CIA gave Zahedi's government $5 million, and Zahedi himself received an extra $1 million.

quote: ב-15 באוגוסט התבקש נעמת אללה נסירי מפקד במשמר המלכותי  של השאה להעביר למוסדאק את מכתב הפיטורין מטעם השאה, אך מוסדאק שהוזהר מפני המזימה לפיטורו סירב לקבל את המכתב והורה לאסור את נסירי.
translation: On 15 August Nematollah Nassiri, a commander in the Shah's royal guard, was asked to deliver the Shah's dismissal letter to Mosaddegh, but Mosaddegh, warned of the plot, refused the letter and ordered Nassiri arrested.

quote: Oberst Nematollah Nassiri, Leiter der Imperial Guard, begab sich am Abend des 15. August zum Haus von Mossadegh und übergab ihm die von Schah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi unterzeichnete Entlassungsurkunde.
translation: Colonel Nematollah Nassiri, head of the Imperial Guard, went to Mosaddegh's house on the evening of 15 August and handed him the dismissal certificate signed by Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi.

quote: Ainsi, lorsque vers minuit, le 15 août, lorsque le colonel Nematollah Nassiri arrive avec deux camions de militaires pour remettre l'ordre de destitution à Mossadegh et l'arrêter, il est lui-même arrêté par des troupes loyalistes.
translation: Thus, when around midnight on 15 August Colonel Nematollah Nassiri arrives with two truckloads of soldiers to deliver the dismissal order to Mosaddegh and arrest him, he is himself arrested by loyalist troops.

quote: صبح ۲۵ مرداد خبر اقدام نصیری در شهر منتشر شد و همه دانستند که کوششی برای برکناری مصدق صورت گرفت و ناموفق بود. کودتای ۲۵ مرداد شکست خورده بود.
translation: On the morning of 25 Mordad news of Nassiri's action spread, and everyone knew an attempt to remove Mosaddegh had been made and had failed. The 25 Mordad coup had failed.

quote: On Sunday 16 August at around 1 a.m., Colonel Nassiri, personally delivered to Mosaddegh the firman (decree) from the Shah dismissing him, but Mossadegh refused to grant Nassiri an audience in person.
So ist es nicht verwunderlich, dass in Teheran nur 170 Nein-Stimmen abgegeben wurden.
translation: So it is not surprising that in Tehran only 170 no votes were cast.

quote: Le vote donne une réponse sans appel : la proposition de dissolution l'emporte avec une majorité de 99,94 %.
section: Référendum sur la dissolution du Parlement
translation: The vote gives a clear answer: the dissolution proposal wins with a majority of 99.94 percent.

quote: it passed with 99.9 percent approval, 2,043,300 votes to 1300 votes against.
با برگزاری همه‌پرسی و اعلام حمایت مردم از دولت و انحلال مجلس دیگر معلوم بود که شاه و بریتانیا باید دست از اقدامات به ظاهر قانونی خود بردارند و رو در رو، مصدق را ساقط کند.
translation: With the referendum and the announcement of public support for the government and the dissolution of parliament, it was clear that the Shah and Britain had to abandon apparently legal measures and overthrow Mosaddegh face to face.

quote: Ajax Operasyonu, 1953 İran Darbesi (resmî adı: TP-AJAX), Birleşik Krallık ve ABD tarafından, İran'ın demokratik olarak seçilen milliyetçi kabinesi ve başbakanı Muhammed Musaddık'ı devirmek ve Pehlevi ailesini yeniden iktidara getirmek amacıyla düzenlenen örtülü harekâttır.
translation: Operation Ajax, the 1953 Iran coup (official name TP-AJAX), was a covert operation by the United Kingdom and the United States to overthrow Iran's democratically elected nationalist cabinet and prime minister Mohammad Mosaddegh and restore the Pahlavi family to power.

quote: L'opération Ajax est une opération secrète menée en 1953 par le Royaume-Uni et les États-Unis, exécutée par la CIA avec le soutien du MI6 (Secret Intelligence Service), visant à renverser le Premier ministre d'Iran Mohammad Mossadegh pour le remplacer par le général Fazlollah Zahedi.
translation: Operation Ajax was a secret 1953 operation by the United Kingdom and the United States, carried out by the CIA with MI6 support, aimed at overthrowing Iranian prime minister Mohammad Mosaddegh and replacing him with General Fazlollah Zahedi.

quote: کودتای ۲۸ مرداد کودتایی بود که در ۲۸ مرداد ۱۳۳۲ با طرح مشترک آمریکا (تحت نام پروژه تی.پی. آژاکس (به انگلیسی: TP-AJAX Project) یا عملیات آژاکس) و بریتانیا (تحت نام عملیات چکمه) و به رهبری ارتش شاهنشاهی ایران برای تحکیم حکمرانی محمدرضاشاه پهلوی اجرا شد
translation: The 28 Mordad coup was a coup carried out on 28 Mordad 1332 under a joint American plan (TP-AJAX or Operation Ajax) and British plan (Operation Boot), led by the Imperial Iranian Army, to consolidate Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi's rule.

quote: Como parte de eso, la CIA organizó guerrillas anticomunistas para luchar contra el Partido Tudeh si tomaban el poder en el caos de la «Operación Ajax». Los documentos publicados del Archivo de Seguridad Nacional mostraron que el subsecretario de Estado Walter Bedell Smith informó que la CIA había acordado con los líderes tribales kashgai, en el sur de Irán, establecer un refugio clandestino desde donde pudieran operar guerrillas y espías financiados por Estados Unidos.
translation: As part of that, the CIA organized anti-Communist guerrillas to fight the Tudeh Party if they seized power in the chaos of 'Operation Ajax'. Released National Security Archive documents showed that Undersecretary of State Walter Bedell Smith reported that the CIA had agreed with Qashqai tribal leaders, in southern Iran, to establish a clandestine haven from where US-funded guerrillas and spies could operate.

quote: En planifiant l’opération, la CIA prend ses précautions pour empêcher le parti communiste Tudeh de prendre le pouvoir dans le cas d'un échec de l’opération Ajax : Selon des documents autrefois classés « top secret » de la National Security Archive, le sous-secrétaire d’État Walter Bedell Smith révèle que la CIA est parvenue à un accord avec des chefs de tribu Qashqai dans le sud de l’Iran, afin d’établir un refuge pour que les agents et guérillas financés par les États-Unis puissent opérer.
translation: In planning the operation, the CIA took precautions to prevent the Tudeh communist party from taking power in the event of a failure of Operation Ajax: According to formerly 'top secret' documents from the National Security Archive, Undersecretary of State Walter Bedell Smith revealed that the CIA reached an agreement with Qashqai tribal leaders in southern Iran to establish a haven so that US-financed agents and guerrillas could operate.

quote:
والتر اسمیت معاون وزیر خارجه وقت به کاخ سفید اطلاع داد که سازمان سیا برای مقابله با این احتمال، آماده شده است تا در صورت شکست کودتا یک جنگ چریکی دراز مدت و دامنه‌دار علیه اعضای حزب توده و دیگر فعالان سیاسی در ایران به راه بیندازد. اسمیت در این یادداشت نوشته است: «تا امروز سیا موفق شده ده نفر را با دستگاه‌های گیرنده و فرستنده رادیویی در نقاط مختلف ایران بگمارد تا در صورت لزوم با این سازمان تماس برقرار کنند. عده دیگری هم برای پیوستن به آن‌ها تعلیم می‌بینند.»

در همان حال، در پایگاه ویلوس فیلد در لیبی که در آن زمان در اختیار آمریکا بود اسلحه و مهمات برای این منظور انبار شده بود. به گفته اسمیت این مقدار اسلحه و مهمات برای مسلح کردن ده هزار نفر کفایت می‌کرد.
translation: Then-Undersecretary of State Walter Smith informed the White House that to counter this possibility, the CIA had prepared to launch a long-term, wide-ranging guerrilla war against Tudeh Party members and other political activists in Iran if the coup failed. Smith wrote in this memo: 'To date, the CIA has succeeded in stationing ten people with radio receivers and transmitters in various parts of Iran to contact this organization if necessary. Others are also being trained to join them.' At the same time, weapons and ammunition had been stockpiled for this purpose at Wheelus Field base in Libya, which was then at US disposal. According to Smith, this amount of weapons and ammunition was sufficient to arm ten thousand people.

quote: As part of that, the CIA organized anti-Communist guerrillas to fight the Tudeh Party if they seized power in the chaos of Operation Ajax. Released National Security Archive documents showed that Undersecretary of State Walter Bedell Smith reported that the CIA had agreed with Qashqai tribal leaders, in south Iran, to establish a clandestine safe haven from which U.S.-funded guerrillas and spies could operate.

در ۵ شهریور ۱۳۹۲ نمایندگان مجلس شورای اسلامی ایران با دو فوریت طرحی موافقت کردند که در صورت تصویب نهایی، دولت را به پیگیری حقوقی و سیاسی دریافت خسارت از آمریکا و بریتانیا در ارتباط با کودتای ۲۸ مرداد علیه دولت محمد مصدق ملزم خواهد کرد.
translation: On 5 Shahrivar 1392 [27 August 2013], representatives of the Islamic Consultative Assembly of Iran agreed to the double-urgency of a bill which, if finally approved, would oblige the government to pursue legally and politically the receipt of damages from the US and Britain in connection with the 28 Mordad coup against Mohammad Mosaddegh's government.

quote: מוסאדק עצמו נמלט לאחר שטנק ירה פגז על ביתו, אך מאוחר יותר הסגיר עצמו לצבא.
section: הצתת תנועות אזרחיות דרך מימון תנועות
translation: Mosaddegh himself fled after a tank fired a shell at his house, but later turned himself in to the army.

quote: Mosaddegh huyó después de que un tanque disparase un solo proyectil contra su casa, pero luego se entregó a la custodia del ejército.
translation: Mosaddegh fled after a tank fired a single shell at his house, but later turned himself in to army custody.

quote: Les troupes fidèles à Mossadegh et quelques civils affrontent les manifestants émeutiers, un lutte finale qui fit 41 morts.
translation: Troops loyal to Mosaddegh and some civilians confronted the rioting demonstrators, a final struggle that left 41 dead.

quote: یک واحد تانکی به هدایت سرتیپ هدایت الله گیلانشاه زاهدی را از خانه امن سیا خارج کرد و به خانه مصدق حمله کرد که نبردی طولانی در آن درگرفت. نخست‌وزیر و شمار متعددی از همکارانش به خانه یک همسایه گریختند ولی در روز بعد تسلیم نیروهای زاهدی شدند.
translation: A tank unit led by Brigadier General Hedayatollah Gilanshah took Zahedi out of the CIA safe house and attacked Mosaddegh's house, where a long battle took place. The Prime Minister and several of his colleagues fled to a neighbor's house, but surrendered to Zahedi's forces the next day.

quote: A large crowd of Tehran residents began to gather around Mosaddegh's house to seize the main base of the government. The Residence Guard opened fire on the crowd and resisted for several hours. Nearly 40 people, mostly civilians, were killed by Mosaddegh's Guard.

Die Sowjetunion fragte am 9. August 1953 an, ob ein Verhandlungsteam in den Iran kommen könne, um Mossadegh Wirtschaftshilfe und die Rückgabe von elf Tonnen Gold anzubieten, die die Sowjetunion nach dem Abzug ihrer Truppen nach Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs aus dem Iran mitgenommen hatte.
section: Sowjetisches Angebot zur Rückgabe der iranischen Goldbestände
translation: The Soviet Union asked on 9 August 1953 whether a negotiating team could come to Iran to offer Mosaddegh economic aid and the return of eleven tons of gold that the Soviet Union had taken from Iran after the withdrawal of its troops at the end of the Second World War.

quote: L'Union soviétique demande à Mossadegh le 9 août 1953 si une équipe de négociation pourrait venir en Iran pour offrir une aide économique au pays, ainsi que le retour de onze tonnes d'or, que l'Union soviétique avait prises après le retrait de ses troupes du pays lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale en Iran.
translation: The Soviet Union asked Mosaddegh on 9 August 1953 if a negotiating team could come to Iran to offer economic aid to the country, as well as the return of eleven tons of gold, which the Soviet Union had taken after the withdrawal of its troops from the country during World War II in Iran.

quote: במקביל מומנה קבוצה שנייה של מסתננים, מסתננים אלו התחזו לתומכי השאה, ארגנו ועודדו מחאות המוניות של איראנים זועמים המבוהלים מ"המהפכה הקומוניסטית" והאלימות המופעלת על ידם.
section: הצתת תנועות אזרחיות דרך מימון תנועות
translation: At the same time a second group of infiltrators was funded; these infiltrators posed as supporters of the Shah, organized and encouraged mass protests of angry Iranians terrified of the 'communist revolution' and the violence used by them.

quote: Según los documentos y registros desclasificados de la CIA, algunos de los mafiosos más temidos en Teherán fueron contratados por la CIA para organizar disturbios pro-Sha el 19 de agosto. Otros hombres pagados por la CIA fueron llevados a Teherán en autobuses y camiones, y se apoderaron de las calles de la ciudad.
translation: According to the CIA's declassified documents and records, some of the most feared mobsters in Tehran were hired by the CIA to stage pro-Shah riots on 19 August. Other men paid by the CIA were brought into Tehran in buses and trucks, and took over the streets of the city.

quote: Dependiendo de los gastos a contar, el costo final se estima que varía de $100 000 a $20 millones. La CIA le dio al gobierno de Zahedi $5 millones después del golpe con el propio Zahedi recibiendo un millón extra.
section: Publicación de documentos y reconocimiento oficial
translation: Depending on the expenses to be counted, the final cost is estimated to vary from $100,000 to $20 million. The CIA gave Zahedi's government $5 million after the coup with Zahedi himself receiving an extra million.

quote: Selon Villiers, pour l'opération visant au rétablissement du chah, la CIA avait dépensé exactement 32 643 000 rials, ce qui représentait à cette époque une somme de 390 000 dollars américains.
translation: According to Villiers, for the operation aimed at restoring the Shah, the CIA had spent exactly 32,643,000 rials, which represented at that time a sum of 390,000 US dollars.

quote: سیا مبلغ زیادی را برای انجام این عملیات پرداخت کرد. بسته به هزینه‌هایی که باید محاسبه شود، هزینه نهایی از ۱۰۰۰۰۰ تا ۲۰ میلیون دلار تخمین زده می‌شود. سیا بعد از کودتا ۵ میلیون دلار به دولت زاهدی داد و خود زاهدی یک میلیون دلار اضافی دریافت کرد.
translation: The CIA paid a large sum to carry out this operation. Depending on the costs to be calculated, the final cost is estimated from $100,000 to $20 million. The CIA gave $5 million to Zahedi's government after the coup and Zahedi himself received an additional one million dollars.

quote: Oberst Nematollah Nassiri, Leiter der Imperial Guard, begab sich am Abend des 15. August zum Haus von Mossadegh und übergab ihm die von Schah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi unterzeichnete Entlassungsurkunde. Mossadegh unterzeichnete den Erhalt der Entlassungsurkunde. Nassiri verließ das Haus von Mossadegh und begab sich zum Stabschef der Armee, Riahi. Dort wurde Nassiri festgenommen.
translation: Colonel Nematollah Nassiri, head of the Imperial Guard, went on the evening of 15 August to Mosaddegh's house and handed him the dismissal certificate signed by Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. Mosaddegh signed the receipt of the dismissal certificate. Nassiri left Mosaddegh's house and went to the Army Chief of Staff, Riahi. There Nassiri was arrested.

quote: Nematollah Nassiri arriva le soir du 15 août à la maison de Mossadegh. Chose étrange et qui fut à l'origine d'un important dysfonctionnement : il arriva en retard, à minuit, et non à 23 h. Introduit dans la résidence, il fit délivrer à Mossadegh par son valet le décret de révocation ayant reçu la sanction royale. Mossadegh signa l'obtention du certificat de libération. Nassiri sortit de la maison de Mossadegh, mais fut arrêté au domicile du Premier ministre.
section: Tentative de Révocation de Mossadegh le 15 août
translation: Nematollah Nassiri arrived the evening of 15 August at Mosaddegh's house. Strangely, and the cause of a major malfunction: he arrived late, at midnight, and not at 11 p.m. Admitted into the residence, he had the dismissal decree with royal sanction delivered to Mosaddegh by his valet. Mosaddegh signed the receipt of the dismissal certificate. Nassiri left Mosaddegh's house, but was arrested at the Prime Minister's residence.

quote: فرمان عزل را یک ساعت بعد از نیمه شب ۲۵ مرداد نعمت‌الله نصیری رئیس گارد سلطنتی (گارد جاویدان) بود با همراهی تانک و زره‌پوش از سعدآباد به خیابان کاخ (خیابان فلسطین کنونی) آورد تا در منزل مصدق به او ابلاغ کند. مصدق که با تلفن از حرکت این گروه باخبر شده بود فرمان را گرفت و رسید داد و نیروی محافظ مقر او بلافاصله نصیری و نیروی همراه او را بازداشت کردند.
translation: One hour after midnight on 25 Mordad [16 August], Nematollah Nassiri, head of the Royal Guard (Immortal Guard), accompanied by tanks and armored vehicles, brought the dismissal decree from Sa'dabad to Kakh Street (now Palestine Street) to serve it to Mosaddegh at his house. Mosaddegh, who had been informed by telephone of this group's movement, took the decree and gave a receipt, and the guard force of his headquarters immediately arrested Nassiri and his accompanying force.

quote: On Sunday 16 August at around 1 a.m., Colonel Nassiri, personally delivered to Mosaddegh the firman (decree) from the Shah dismissing him, but Mossadegh refused to grant Nassiri an audience in person. Instead, he instructed Colonel Ezzatollah Momtaz, an officer of the Prime Minister's Office's Security Guard to intercept Nassiri, retrieved the document and brought it to his quarters. After reading the firman, he rejected it and immediately had Nassiri arrested.

El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores y el asociado más cercano de Mosaddegh, Hossein Fatemi, fue ejecutado por orden de la corte militar del sha mediante un pelotón de fusilamiento el 10 de noviembre de 1954.
translation: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and closest associate of Mosaddegh, Hossein Fatemi, was executed by order of the Shah's military court by firing squad on 10 November 1954.

quote: Министр иностранных дел и ближайший соратник Мосаддыка Хоссейн Фатеми был казнён по приказу шахского военного трибунала путем расстрела 10 ноября 1954 года.
translation: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and closest associate of Mosaddegh, Hossein Fatemi, was executed by order of the Shah's military tribunal by firing squad on 10 November 1954.

quote: On 19 August, demonstrators and military units backed by the CIA gained control of key institutions in Tehran and seized the government, leading to Mosaddegh's overthrow on 19 August, allowing the Shah to return to Iran on 22 August.

19 августа агенты ЦРУ с участием прошахского крыла мусульманского духовенства организовали в Тегеране проплаченные массовые беспорядки, в ходе которых скандировались прошахские лозунги и требовали смерти премьер-министра.
translation: On 19 August CIA agents, with the participation of the pro-Shah wing of the Muslim clergy, organised paid mass disturbances in Tehran, during which pro-Shah slogans were chanted and the prime minister’s death was demanded.

quote: Le vote donne une réponse sans appel : la proposition de dissolution l'emporte avec une majorité de 99,94 %. Mais les personnes ne rendent publiquement dans ses isoloirs séparés pour voter oui ou non.
section: Référendum sur la dissolution du Parlement
translation: The vote gives an unequivocal answer: dissolution wins with a 99.94% majority. But people publicly go to separate polling booths to vote yes or no.

quote: In early August, a week before the coup, a referendum to dissolve parliament and give the prime minister power to make law was submitted to voters, and it passed with 99.9 percent approval, 2,043,300 votes to 1300 votes against.

Le Parlement fut ainsi dissous, de nouvelles élections prévues; mais aucune date n'est avancée : c'est une occasion pour le chah de renvoyer son Premier ministre : selon la Constitution, le monarque peut démettre le chef du gouvernement selon sa volonté, mais l’usage a été pris que le chef d’État se repose sur le « pressentiment » du Majlis avant de nommer un gouvernement ; en l’absence de Parlement, le chah reprend cette prérogative.
section: Référendum sur la dissolution du Parlement
translation: Parliament was thus dissolved and new elections planned, but no date was given: this was an opportunity for the Shah to dismiss his prime minister. According to the constitution, the monarch could dismiss the head of government at will, but custom required reliance on the Majlis’s indication before appointing a government; in parliament’s absence, the Shah regained this prerogative.

quote: Sin embargo, la constitución en ese momento permitió tal acción, que Mosaddegh consideró injusto.
translation: However, the constitution at that time permitted such action, which Mosaddegh considered unjust.

quote: On 15 August, an officer of the Imperial Guard of the Shah (Persian for 'king') was dispatched to Tehran to deliver the Shah's dismissal decree to Mosaddegh, a move that was legally questionable under the 1906–1907 Iranian Constitution.
Nassiri verließ das Haus von Mossadegh und begab sich zum Stabschef der Armee, Riahi. Dort wurde Nassiri festgenommen.
translation: Nassiri left Mosaddegh’s house and went to the army chief of staff, Riahi. Nassiri was arrested there.

quote: Nassiri sortit de la maison de Mossadegh, mais fut arrêté au domicile du Premier ministre.
section: Tentative de Révocation de Mossadegh le 15 août
translation: Nassiri left Mosaddegh’s house but was arrested at the prime minister’s home.

quote: Ein am 3. August 1953 abgehaltenes Referendum zur Auflösung des Parlaments erhielt eine Mehrheit von 99,94 %.
translation: A referendum held on 3 August 1953 on dissolving parliament obtained a 99.94% majority.

quote: Le 4 août a lieu le référendum, lancé par Mossadegh, pour la dissolution de l'Assemblée.
translation: The referendum initiated by Mosaddegh to dissolve the Assembly takes place on 4 August.

quote: Bewaffnete Auseinandersetzungen zwischen Mossadegh-Anhängern und General Zahedi ergebenen Truppen fanden überwiegend vor dem Haus Mossadeghs statt und forderten über 200 Tote und 300 Verwundete.
section: Pro-Schah-Demonstrationen – Militär und Polizei vereinigen sich mit den Demonstranten
translation: Armed clashes between Mosaddegh supporters and troops loyal to General Zahedi took place mainly outside Mosaddegh’s house and claimed more than 200 dead and 300 wounded.

quote: Les affrontements armés entre les partisans de Mossadegh et les troupes fidèles au général Zahedi ayant eu lieu principalement en dehors de la maison Mossadegh firent plus de 200 morts et 300 blessés.
translation: Armed clashes between Mosaddegh’s supporters and troops loyal to General Zahedi, taking place mainly outside Mosaddegh’s house, caused more than 200 deaths and 300 injuries.

quote: Entre 200 y 300 personas murieron a causa del conflicto.
translation: Between 200 and 300 people died as a result of the conflict.

quote: قُتل ما بين 200  و300 شخص جراء النزاع.
translation: Between 200 and 300 people were killed in the conflict.

quote: بین ۲۰۰ و ۳۰۰ نفر بر اثر درگیری کشته شدند.
translation: Between 200 and 300 people were killed as a result of the fighting.

quote: Between 200 and 300 people were killed because of the conflict.
Летом 1952 года Мосаддык потребовал себе на шесть месяцев чрезвычайные полномочия и пост министра обороны, что позволяло ему лишить шаха его опоры — промонархически настроенного офицерства.
translation: In the summer of 1952 Mosaddegh demanded emergency powers for six months and the post of defence minister, which would let him deprive the Shah of his support, the pro-monarchist officer corps.

quote: Ya en agosto de 1952, comenzó a confiar en los poderes de emergencia para gobernar, generando controversia entre sus partidarios.
section: Últimos meses del gobierno de Mosaddegh
translation: As early as August 1952, he began to rely on emergency powers to govern, generating controversy among his supporters.

quote: Am 3. August 1952 verabschiedete das iranische Parlament ein Ermächtigungsgesetz, nach dem alle von Mossadegh unterzeichneten Gesetzesentwürfe unmittelbar Rechtskraft erlangten, auch wenn sie vom Parlament und Senat noch nicht diskutiert und verabschiedet und vom Schah unterschrieben waren.
translation: On 3 August 1952 the Iranian parliament passed an enabling act (Ermächtigungsgesetz), under which all bills signed by Mossadegh took effect at once, even if they had not yet been debated and passed by parliament and the senate or signed by the Shah.

quote: As early as August 1952, he began to rely on emergency powers to rule, generating controversy among his supporters.
Nach 60 Jahren hat auch erstmals die CIA selbst ihre Beteiligung an der Operation Ajax öffentlich eingeräumt.
section: Zur Beteiligung der CIA beim Umsturz 1953
translation: After 60 years the CIA itself publicly admitted its involvement in Operation Ajax for the first time.

quote: באוגוסט 2013, 60 שנה לאחר ההפיכה, הודתה סוכנות הביון המרכזית (CIA) כי הוטלה עליה האחריות לתכנן ולבצע את ההפיכה, שכללה מתן שוחד לפוליטיקאים איראנים ולגורמים רמי-דרג בצבא ובמשטרה, כמו גם הפצת תעמולה שתמכה בהפיכה.
translation: In August 2013, 60 years after the coup, the Central Intelligence Agency admitted that it had been given responsibility for planning and carrying out the coup, which included bribing Iranian politicians and senior army and police officials, as well as spreading propaganda in support of the coup.

quote: نویسنده نیوزیلندی اندرو اسکات کوپر در کتاب سقوط بهشت خود اشاره می‌کند که کودتایی اتفاق نیفتاده است و تنها در روز ۲۸ مرداد مردم ایران خودجوش و بدون برنامه قبلی به خیابان‌ها و معابر عمومی آمدند و اعتراض کردند.
translation: The New Zealand author Andrew Scott Cooper, in his book The Fall of Heaven, points out that no coup took place and that only on 28 Mordad did the people of Iran come into the streets spontaneously and without prior plan, and protested.

quote: В 2023 году ЦРУ взяло на себя ответственность за этот переворот, что противоречит предыдущим оценкам учёных о том, что ЦРУ провалило операцию.
translation: In 2023 the CIA took responsibility for this coup, which contradicts earlier assessments by scholars that the CIA had failed in the operation.

quote: Die Gegner des derzeitigen Regimes im Iran würden mit einer revisionistischen Geschichtsschreibung antworten, die durch Autoren wie den ehemaligen iranischen Diplomaten Darioush Bayandor und Ray Takeyh veröffentlicht würden.
section: Zur Beteiligung der CIA beim Umsturz 1953
translation: Opponents of the current regime in Iran, it says, respond with a revisionist historiography published by authors such as the former Iranian diplomat Darioush Bayandor and Ray Takeyh.

quote: It has even been suggested that Roosevelt's activities between 15 and 19 August were primarily intended to organize "stay-behind networks as part of the planned CIA evacuation of the country", although they allowed him to later "claim responsibility for the day's outcome." In 2014, historian Ray Takeyh stated that the US-led coup attempt failed, citing how the CIA wrote to Eisenhower that "The move failed [...] We now [...] probably have to snuggle up to Mosaddeq if we're going to save [our influence in Iran];" the demonstrations that led to Mosaddegh's resignation took place some weeks after the Roosevelt-organized ones, and were composed of average citizens, not the thugs-for-hire that the CIA and MI6 had recruited.
جلبت وكالة المخابرات المركزية رجالًا مأجورين إلى طهران في حافلات وشاحنات، واستولوا على شوارع المدينة.
translation: The CIA brought hired men to Tehran in buses and trucks, and they took over the city's streets.

quote: Le chah ayant fui le pays, l'armée du général Fazlollah Zahedi et le clergé, dirigé par le grand ayatollah Hossein Boroudjerdi, organisèrent de massives manifestations pro-chah à travers le pays, ce qui fit basculer la situation et l'opinion publique et politique, et Mossadegh fut finalement renversé le 19 août.
translation: With the Shah having fled the country, the army of General Fazlollah Zahedi and the clergy, led by Grand Ayatollah Hossein Boroujerdi, organised massive pro-Shah demonstrations across the country, which tipped the situation and public and political opinion, and Mossadegh was finally overthrown on 19 August.

quote: Erst durch massive Pro-Schah-Demonstrationen im ganzen Land, die von der Geistlichkeit auf Anweisung von Großajatollah Hossein Borudscherdi organisiert worden waren, wendete sich die politische Lage, und Mossadegh gab auf.
translation: Only through massive pro-Shah demonstrations across the country, organised by the clergy on the instruction of Grand Ayatollah Hossein Borujerdi, did the political situation turn, and Mossadegh gave up.

quote: Otros hombres pagados por la CIA fueron llevados a Teherán en autobuses y camiones, y se apoderaron de las calles de la ciudad.
translation: Other men paid by the CIA were brought to Tehran in buses and trucks, and took over the streets of the city.

quote: According to the CIA's declassified documents and records, some of the most feared mobsters in Tehran were hired by the CIA to stage pro-shah riots on 19 August.
مصدق در طی یک رفراندوم از مردم خواست که بین مجلس و دولت یک گزینه را انتخاب کنند و با انتخاب دولت از سوی شرکت کنندگان، مصدق انحلال مجلس را مطابق با نتیجه رفراندوم از شاه درخواست کرد.
translation: In a referendum Mosaddegh asked the people to choose between parliament and the government, and as the participants chose the government, Mosaddegh asked the Shah to dissolve parliament in accordance with the result of the referendum.

quote: Le référendum est gagné à plus de 99 % des voix ce qui le déligitime.
translation: The referendum is won with more than 99% of the votes, which delegitimises it.

quote: Bei dem Referendum wurden getrennte Wahllokale für die Ja- und die Nein-Stimmen aufgestellt.
translation: In the referendum, separate polling stations were set up for the yes and the no votes.

quote: El referéndum amañado fue ampliamente visto por los opositores como un acto dictatorial, y el sah y el resto del gobierno fueron despojados efectivamente de sus poderes para gobernar.
section: Últimos meses del gobierno de Mosaddegh
translation: The rigged referendum was widely seen by opponents as a dictatorial act, and the Shah and the rest of the government were effectively stripped of their powers to govern.

quote: The referendum was boycotted by opposition figures and the result was described as fraudulent by many observers.

El golpe de Estado iraní de 1953, conocido en Irán como el golpe de Estado 28 de Mordad (en persa: کودتای ۲۸ مرداد‎), fue el derrocamiento del primer ministro elegido democráticamente, Mohammad Mosaddegh, en favor del fortalecido Mohammad Reza Pahlavi el 19 de agosto de 1953, orquestado por los Estados Unidos (bajo el nombre de TPAJAX Project u «Operación Ajax») y el Reino Unido (bajo el nombre de Operation Boot —«Operación arranque»—).
translation: The Iranian coup of 1953, known in Iran as the 28 Mordad coup, was the overthrow of the democratically elected prime minister, Mohammad Mosaddegh, in favour of the strengthened Mohammad Reza Pahlavi on 19 August 1953, orchestrated by the United States (under the name TPAJAX Project or Operation Ajax) and the United Kingdom (under the name Operation Boot).

quote: رضا پهلوی، ولیعهد پیشین ایران در یک جلسه مطبوعاتی در موسسه هادسون، در سال ۲۰۲۰، با طرح این مسئله که کودتا، اتفاقی است که از رده‌های پایین به بالا اتفاق می‌افتد و نه بالعکس، گفت که این واقعه تنها یک عزل ساده بوده و نه یک کودتا؛ چون اگر واقعاً کودتا بود، شاه ایران، پس از عزل هر نخست‌وزیر و کابینه‌اش، در واقع یک کودتا (جمعا ۳۱ کودتا) انجام داده است.
translation: Reza Pahlavi, the former crown prince of Iran, at a press conference at the Hudson Institute in 2020, arguing that a coup is something that happens from the lower ranks upward and not the reverse, said that this event was only a simple dismissal and not a coup; for if it really were a coup, the Shah of Iran would in effect have staged a coup (31 coups in all) each time he dismissed a prime minister and his cabinet.

quote: Operation Ajax (eigentlich TPAJAX, wobei TP für das CIA-Länder-Kryptonym des Iran und AJAX für den Reiniger „Ajax“ von Colgate-Palmolive steht) war eine geheime Operation der CIA und des MI6 im August 1953 im Iran, mit der der von Schah Mohammed Reza Pahlavi verfassungsmäßig ernannte und vom Parlament bestätigte Premierminister Mohammad Mossadegh gestürzt und Fazlollah Zahedi als neuer Premierminister installiert werden sollte.
translation: Operation Ajax (in fact TPAJAX ...) was a secret operation of the CIA and MI6 in Iran in August 1953 meant to topple Prime Minister Mohammad Mossadegh, constitutionally appointed by Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi and confirmed by parliament, and to install Fazlollah Zahedi as the new prime minister.

quote: Переворот в Иране (1953) — государственный переворот в Иране в 1953 году, повлёкший свержение демократически избранного правительства Национального фронта Ирана.
translation: The coup in Iran (1953): a coup d'état in Iran in 1953 that led to the overthrow of the democratically elected government of the National Front of Iran.

quote: On 19 August 1953, Prime Minister of Iran Mohammad Mosaddegh was overthrown in a coup d'état that strengthened the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran.
